description.narrative: Cumulative Output of The definition of the Kms of Roads Completed means a Turn-Over Certificate (TOC) had been issued by the contractor and received by the DPWH. The breakdown is as follows: CP1=16.36, CP2=16.5, CP3=64.58; CP4=77.51 KMs. Except for CP2, all other CPs were issued with TOC by the Engineer. Only partial TOC was issued for CP2 at segment 4. The remaining works in CP2 of about Php330M is currently being supervised by DPWH. The main carriageway way has already been completed by the Contractor with about 6 KMs unpaved shoulders to be completed under DPWH supervision. By the final update, the total length of completed roads with TOC issued is 174.95. The actual length of carriageways completed is already 222 kms but there are remaining works (drainages, shoulders etc) not yet completed. Hence DPWH cannot issue a ToC.
